blocks.x: We’ll go ahead and start the formal interview. Today is January 13 – man, this snow storm has really taken me out. I’m from California – today is January 13th, 2011.

He ain’t going to let it go – 2013 – 2011. See, you got me tongue-tied now. We are in the Empire Hotel in New York City. This is in the aftermath of the NEA Jazz Masters Award Ceremony held on Tuesday night. We are conducting the Smithsonian National Endowment for the Arts Jazz Oral History Interview with Ferdinand Delfeayo Marsalis. If you could go ahead and state your full name – or restate your full name, since I’ve stated it, your date and place of birth.
